projectDescription: An internal operating system for AI at work — company knowledge, Apps with screens and durable workflows, agents, and governance controls, deployed per-client on Cloudflare Workers.
keyFeatures: Durable workflows with SDK: step.do, step.llm, step.decision, step.sleep
App screens with live server updates via useLive and useWorkflow hooks
Model gateway routing all LLM calls with rules, budgets and audit
Connector layer (connect Worker) as the sole OAuth and egress point
Knowledge base with versioned Markdown documents, search, and agent access
Hash-chained audit log covering every model call, connector action, and permission change
Permission system: Apps and agents start with nothing; every resource needs an explicit grant
Deployed per-client into the client's own Cloudflare account in the EU
Screen compiler that builds React screens with no network access (sandboxed iframes)
Agent (Pi in Code Mode) writing code against typed APIs to answer questions and take actions
publicApiSurface: step.do(name, options, fn) — runs plain code, durable
step.llm(name, options) — calls model gateway, validates schema
step.decision(name, options) — asks a person, waits for answer
step.sleep(name, options) — durably pauses the run
appServer<Server>(env) — typed stub for the App's own server methods
appExports<Exports>(binding) — typed stub for another App's exports
money / number / text / person / schedule / model / template — param helpers
